investment_strategy: Build a quality-first, AI-focused portfolio tilted to resilient platform leaders with strong earnings power and positive analyst support, complemented by a small, high-upside AI infrastructure position. With the VIX near 17 (moderate risk sentiment) and 10Y yields ~4.6% (valuation headwind), overweight lower-volatility, cash-generative mega-cap platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) and keep a capped tactical stake in Nvidia to participate in the AI infrastructure cycle while managing drawdown risk. Anticipate intermittent volatility from regulation, export controls, and AI capex scrutiny; size positions accordingly and prioritize firms with diversified revenue, strong ROE, and recent earnings beats.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Quality AI platforms plus capped high-upside infrastructure exposure, sized for a moderate-volatility regime and elevated-rate environment.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility and strong fundamentals (earnings/revenue growth, ROE), consistent EPS beats, positive analyst consensus, and constructive news catalysts; incorporated momentum while sizing down higher-beta names due to VIX ~17 and 10Y ~4.6%.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously bullish on AI-driven technology over the long term with near-term volatility from regulation, export controls, and capex scrutiny. Expect continued strength in platforms and selective outperformance in AI infrastructure, tempered by higher discount rates.
